descriptionlist.description: Groups Lock Screen and Notification Center notifications by app in a clean Priority Hub-style icon bar.
Modernized for iOS 15-16+ rootless jailbreaks (Dopamine & Palera1n) using standard Theos rootless paths.
Fixes stuck zombie notifications on iOS 15-16 by syncing SpringBoard's NCNotificationMasterList and handling remote/app dismissals properly.
Fixes dynamic Left, Center, and Right alignment calculations on layout resize.

changelog.change: Fixed stuck notifications and synced clear-all hooks on NCNotificationStructuredListViewController
Fixed dynamic Left/Center/Right layout alignment and section inset recalculation
